/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
class PageParser(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.headings = 0
        self.phone = False
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == 'h1': self.headings += 1
        if tag == 'a' and dict(attrs).get('href') == 'tel:+15035550142': self.phone = True
page = Path('index.html').read_text()
parser = PageParser()
parser.feed(page)
assert parser.headings == 1
assert parser.phone
assert 'July 1–21, 2027' in page
assert 'datetime=\"2027-07-22\"' in page
assert '<meta name=\"viewport\"' in page
assert '<script' not in page
print('Verified: renovation dates, reopening date, phone link, responsive viewport, and self-contained page.')
PY"
